name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Huh... You into places like this? I'd never come here, not even on New Year's."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I mean, I don't even know the difference between shrines and temples."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So, is this a temple? ...Oh, it's a shrine? Oh, okay. Whatever."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Shiori ain't here. Let's hit our next spot."
Might as well pay my respects.

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hm? Oh, are you gonna pray she shows up? Sure, go ahead~"
How much should I put in?

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Whoa, that's a lot. Hope the deity grants your wish."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Whoa, are you for real? You're really putting in *that* much?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Wait, how much was that again? 1129 yen? 1129... as in "ii niku"? Are you dumb or what?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "What're you acting all smug for? I just called you out! C'mon, chop chop."
